_schema.title: human-readable title of the source document
_schema.source_url: the exact official URL this was retrieved from
_schema.retrieved_date: YYYY-MM-DD, the date we downloaded/saved it
_schema.effective_date: YYYY-MM-DD if the source states when the rule took effect, else null
_schema.local_path: path under data/raw/<doc_type>/ where the file is saved
_schema.verified: true if a live browser navigation to source_url was confirmed working during recon, false if only found via search and not yet directly confirmed
_schema.render_js: true if this source is a JS-rendered SPA page where plain HTTP GET returns only the page shell (no real content) - must be fetched with a headless browser instead. Omitted/false for static PDFs and server-rendered HTML.
_schema.notes: anything about ambiguity, contradictions with other sources, or scraping difficulty

documents.title: FAQ - PAN Application Procedure (incl. POI/POA/DOB document lists) | Protean (formerly NSDL/TIN)
documents.notes: REPLACED original source (services/pan/documents-required.html) which uses click-to-reveal tabs where the actual document list never appears in the DOM even after JS render - only section headers like '1.1 Indian Citizen' load with no content, would need per-tab click automation to extract. This FAQ page covers the same information (full POI/POA/DOB document lists including minor/HUF/NRI/foreign-citizen conditional cases, plus fee schedule) and renders correctly with Playwright. Domain migrated from protean-tinpan.com to tinpan.proteantech.in.
